breakdown.description: The `turbulenceProperties` dictionary specifies both `simulationType LES` and a `RAS` sub-dictionary. A simulation can be either LES or RANS, but not both simultaneously in this manner.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly includes the RAS sub-dictionary ('Include a RAS sub-dictionary specifying RASModel as kOmegaSST, turbulence on, and printCoeffs on, exactly as provided by the user'), directly repeating the original error. The ground truth requires only the LES configuration without any RAS sub-dictionary. The agent did not resolve this inconsistency.
